about_the_game:
Pre-purchase Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition to experience two new campaigns, new destinations, gear, and much more. Pre-purchase now to get access to both expansions (Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate and Destiny 2: Renegades), plus Rewards Pass access, along with access to the raid/epic raid and dungeon/epic dungeon content, all upon release.

Pre-purchase now to unlock a number of pre-purchase rewards, including the Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate Pre-Purchase Rewards (Exotic Ghost and Legendary Emblem), the Destiny 2: Renegades Pre-Purchase Rewards (Exotic Ship and Legendary Emblem, available before the launch of Renegades), plus instantly unlocked pre-purchase rewards (New Land Beyond Exotic Sniper Rifle, Year of Prophecy Exotic Emote, and the Dark Side Legends Bundle.)

In addition, the Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition includes the Secret Stash (1x Exotic Cosmetic, 1x Exotic Cipher, 2x Ascendant Alloys, 3x Ascendant Shards, delivered with each seasonal release), the New Land Beyond Exotic Sniper Rifle ornament and catalyst, the Year of Prophecy Exotic Sparrow, and access to the Year of Prophecy Rewards Pass seasonal updates throughout the year.

Experience a full year of exploration and adventure with the Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition, featuring two expansions – Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate and Destiny 2: Renegades – and the start of a new saga in Destiny.

Your journey begins with a mysterious invitation. Uncover powerful new weapons and armor, master new abilities, and challenge yourself and your fireteam across two new destinations, and an all-new raid and dungeon. The Guardian’s future is now, as a new saga begins, setting the stage for conflicts and revelations ahead.

More information on the next expansion – Destiny 2: Renegades – coming soon!
